decisions.reason: Schlager compilations are a core catalog genre for this kind of specialist label, and back-catalog CDs usually stay listed at little cost while they remain in stock.
An illustrated release series builds the label's curated identity and can be extended with new volumes, so keeping it is worthwhile.
Reissued jazz vinyl fits the ongoing vinyl demand and the firm's genre expansion, though pressings may sell out and not be repressed.
Multi-disc box sets are often limited editions that can sell out, but while stock remains they stay a flagship collector item.
A standard compilation CD was only mentioned, not given its own page, yet it costs little to keep in a warehouse-backed catalog of over 60,000 items.
